title: Skill Manifest
description: Validation schema for the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file, per the agentskills.io open specification.

name.description: Must equal the parent directory name exactly.

description.description: Must state WHAT the skill does and WHEN to use it. No angle brackets.

allowed-tools.description: Tools this skill is pre-approved to use, as a space-separated string or a list.

compatibility.description: Free-text note on environment requirements (filesystem, network, MCP).

metadata.description: Free-form nested metadata, e.g. category, difficulty, related skills.
